entity.description: Maker of brake and door components for rail vehicles, based in Leipzig.

summary: One red flag was found: the German competition authority fined Veltrava EUR 4.2 million for price-fixing in March 2026, and the company has appealed. Watch items include a door-actuator recall, a July 2026 profit warning, a February 2026 strike that delayed deliveries, and an allegation on an unverified blog about brake-pad test reports that no trusted source confirms. Reputation could not be assessed because no trusted source returned evidence.

flags.summary: Fined EUR 4.2 million by the German competition authority for price-fixing in rail brake pads; not yet final.
flags.quote: Veltrava Rail Components GmbH, Leipzig, was fined EUR 4.2 million. The decision is not yet final.
flags.quote_context: Bonn, 11 March 2026. The Bundeskartellamt has imposed fines totalling EUR 9.8 million on two manufacturers of rail brake pads for price-fixing. Veltrava Rail Components GmbH, Leipzig, was fined EUR 4.2 million. The decision is not yet final.

flags.summary: Recall of about 1,800 door actuators (sensor fault) in August 2026; replacements due by December.

flags.quote_context: Veltrava Rail Components has recalled around 1,800 door actuators fitted to regional trains after a sensor fault caused doors to open slowly. The company said replacement parts would ship by December.

flags.summary: Profit warning: 2026 operating margin forecast cut to about 4% from 7%.
